title: My Daughter Forged A Dissolution And Sold Our Brand. So I Shipped Her Conviction Worldwide
description: After my daughter forged a dissolution and sold our miniature business for $650K, she never expected me to find the original partnership rolled inside a tiny rug. Now she glues dollhouse chairs in an apron that says 'Small Fraud, Big Consequences' while every order ships with a QR code to her perjury conviction. #TinyLiesMiniatures #FamilyBetrayal #PettyRevenge
thumb_text: HER APRON SAYS SMALL FRAUD BIG CONSEQUENCES
pinned_comment: What would you do if you found your late husband’s 'Save yourself' note hidden inside a dollhouse rug after your daughter forged a dissolution and left you with a $3,000 gift card? Share your story in the comments.
